data.narrative:
Archetype AI is a Series A software and AI company founded by Ivan Poupyrev, Brandon Barbello, Leonardo Giusti, Jaime Lien, and Nick Gillian. The company has raised $48M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private and 1 public company operating in AI & Software, including peers such as Scale AI, Reflection AI, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $48M in total raised as a base proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical for Series A advancement, implies a valuation of $96M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $5.6B, with a range spanning $2.0B to $29.0B. The wide peer distribution reflects heterogeneity in maturity and capital efficiency across the frontier-AI landscape.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $82M (low) to $6.4B (high), with a median point of $2.8B. The significant spread between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects tension between early-stage funding history and market comparables. Key uncertainties include: revenue run-rate and unit economics relative to peers; product-market fit validation; and whether peer valuations reflect sustainable fundamentals or market exuberance in AI frontiers.
